summary: Calc ODS span attributes use the original native Which identifiers, typed members and shared XML codecs through import, export and Worker transfer.
findings: Existing font and decoration routing is preserved. Calc writes its native line-through word-mode attribute for the single word-mode item. Pinned package and styled text ranges reopen with the expected source values.
residual_risks: This change covers ODS edit-run transport. Browser shaping and unrelated full EditEngine property-set behavior remain outside the task.
